description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kurukuththala (Block 01), Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad Map No. 320371 (24/120067)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land ownership claims across multiple districts (Kandy, Puttalam, Kurunegala, Gampaha), which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
